```{=html}
<div class="sm-layout">
  <div class="sm-particle-map" aria-label="Частицы Стандартной модели">
    <div class="sm-sector sm-quark-sector">
      <h3>Кварки</h3>
      <div class="sm-doublet-row">
        <div class="sm-doublet-stack" aria-label="Дублет кварков u и d"><div class="sm-doublet quark-doublet">\(\displaystyle\begin{pmatrix}u\\d\end{pmatrix}\)</div></div>
        <div class="sm-doublet-stack" aria-label="Дублет кварков c и s"><div class="sm-doublet quark-doublet">\(\displaystyle\begin{pmatrix}c\\s\end{pmatrix}\)</div></div>
        <div class="sm-doublet-stack" aria-label="Дублет кварков t и b"><div class="sm-doublet quark-doublet">\(\displaystyle\begin{pmatrix}t\\b\end{pmatrix}\)</div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="sm-multiplicity">\(\times 3\) цвета</div>
    </div>

    <div class="sm-sector sm-lepton-sector">
      <h3>Лептоны</h3>
      <div class="sm-doublet-row">
        <div class="sm-doublet lepton-doublet" aria-label="Электронный лептонный дублет">\(\displaystyle\begin{pmatrix}\nu_e\\e\end{pmatrix}\)</div>
        <div class="sm-doublet lepton-doublet" aria-label="Мюонный лептонный дублет">\(\displaystyle\begin{pmatrix}\nu_\mu\\\mu\end{pmatrix}\)</div>
        <div class="sm-doublet lepton-doublet" aria-label="Тау-лептонный дублет">\(\displaystyle\begin{pmatrix}\nu_\tau\\\tau\end{pmatrix}\)</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="sm-sector sm-boson-sector">
      <h3>Бозоны</h3>
      <div class="sm-boson-row">
        <div class="sm-boson-cell gauge">\(\gamma\)</div>
        <div class="sm-boson-cell gauge">\(W^\pm\)</div>
        <div class="sm-boson-cell gauge">\(Z\)</div>
        <div class="sm-boson-cell gauge sm-gluon-cell"><span>\(g\)</span><span class="sm-boson-multiplicity">\(\times 8\)</span></div>
        <div class="sm-boson-cell higgs">\(H\)</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <ol class="sm-pillars">
    <li><strong>Квантовые поля</strong></li>
    <li><strong>Калибровочная симметрия</strong><br><span class="small">\(SU(3)_C\times SU(2)_L\times U(1)_Y\)</span></li>
    <li><strong>Спонтанное нарушение симметрии</strong><br><span class="small">массы \(W^\pm\), \(Z\) и фермионов</span></li>
  </ol>
</div>
```
